items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, November 11, 2017 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I thought it was a great story by Dustin Hoffman

ctx.x: A British cat I think. I don’t remember. But that scene. I remember watching the scene. I think Dustin Hoffman was on Johnny Carson or something. It was a long time ago. I wasn’t in the music business. And Dustin Hoffman said that he stayed awake all night. He wouldn’t let himself go to sleep so that when he came in the next morning and he was drinking coffee, he was all like, he had the jingles you know. And they’re going to do this scene where he’s interrogating him and they keep him up all night. And he was a…

said, “Well you know I stayed up all night, man, so I could really be in front of the camera.” And the cat says, “Dustin, it’s much easier to just act.” But you got to know how to act. You’ve got to know how to be able to turn the switch on and do it. And that takes a long time to get there. It takes a long time. I thought it was a great story by Dustin Hoffman, and a real nod to this great actor who I apologize for not thinking of his name. But it takes a long time to get it right. And if you get it right that’s…
